card.name: Verb introducing a list after REMS
card.fires_on: The word right before an introduced list, mostly "include" or "are" after a drug's REMS requirements. Also "such as" and "forms" before a colon or list.

modes.label: REMS requirements
modes.description: "include" or "are" after a REMS program name, leading into a list of requirements.
modes.example: Notable requirements of the FABHALTA REMS<< include>> the following: Prescribers must enroll

modes.label: Other list lead-ins
modes.description: A word that sets up a colon or list, such as "as" in "such as" or a noun ending a heading.
modes.example: your doctor will ask questions about your symptoms, such<< as>>:Do you feel short of breath?

card.writes: It lowers the chance of a line break or newline next, favoring a colon or following text to continue.
card.plain: It marks the word just before a list is introduced, as in "requirements include the following:".
